“
I am nothing. I am the empty room. The dreamless sleep. The shadow's shadow. There was no pain before my sister set the sun aflame. Now you exist to suffer until you find your way back to my embrace.
„
— Shar

Overview

Shar is the twin sister and enemy of  Selûne and the patron deity of  Shadowheart. She is associated with the domains of Death and Trickery. Shar cannot be the deity of a custom player cleric.[2]

Shar’s presence is described as a feeling of emptiness, a feeling like one with the darkness, shadows that cloud thoughts and memories, and a feeling of oblivion-like loss.[3]

Church of Shar

Shar is considered an evil goddess, and as such her faithful are both feared and reviled. Sharrans rarely flaunt their worship openly due to this - as well as the fact that it breaks Shar’s teachings to reveal themselves. Worship of Shar is forbidden outright in some places.

Sharrans take pride in secrecy, trickery, interrogation, torture, and stealth. They do not shy away from brutality, and have been known to display their enemies' bodies. Secrecy is valued so highly that some Sharrans undergo a ritual to have their memories temporarily suppressed. Sharran culture is militaristic, given their centuries-old war with the followers of Selûne, often referring to her as the “moonwitch”. Shar has been at war with Selûne since before most history was written, thus making it an eternal conflict in the eyes of mortals. Much of Shar’s creed focuses on waging war against her sister Selûne and initiates of Shar are taught to reject anything that may distract them from their cause, including romance.

Shar is known to be unforgiving[4] and ruthless[5] even toward her own devotees, claiming if any of her warriors are caught, tricked, or blunder[6], they are unworthy[7] and weak. As is her mercurial nature, years (and even a lifetime) of service and devotion may, in some cases, be met with no reward - or response - at all.[8]

Followers of Shar are also enemies of  Lathander and his followers.

Ranks of the Church of Shar from highest to lowest:

  • Mother Superior of Shar
  • Dark Justiciar
  • Justiciar Crusader
  • Sharran Fidelian
  • Sharran Sentry
  • Sharran Novice

Dark Justiciars

Dark Justiciars are an honorary order within the priesthood of Shar, who are granted supernatural abilities and carry out her will throughout Faerûn. They are considered Shar's most elite warriors, known to be formidable in battle - though  Viconia DeVir mentions that they are better deployed as daggers in the shadows, not massed upon a battlefield.

In order to ascend to the rank of a Dark Justiciar, initiates must pass the Gauntlet of Shar; a series of trials that prove a variety of skills valued by the Dark Lady. If the trials are survived, the initiate must kill a cleric of Selûne (for a hundred years, this was the ever-regenerating  Dame Aylin.)

Dark Justiciar equipment is quality gear. A Sharran crossbow is described as powerful, nicer than duergar craft, graceful but hardy, and “exquisitely designed”. Their uniforms are clad with the symbol of Shar. They incorporate various fabrics, including velvet tunics and dark cloaks. Sharran armours are described as fine, “unusually robust”, and handsome.[9]

All Dark Justiciars encountered in Baldur's Gate 3 are dead or undead, with the exception of  Lyrthindor in Grymforge and possibly  Shadowheart herself, who is anointed as one if she makes a certain choice in her personal quest ⁠Daughter of Darkness.

Ceremonies and rituals

The Nightfall Feast (also known as the Nightfall ceremony) is a sacrificial ritual in which worshippers enjoy a banquet in honor of Shar, then kill an innocent in her name. It is considered a sacred rite among her followers and is meant to honor her with an act of wickedness.[10]

On a Moonless night, the faithful of Shar can show their devotion by committing an act of depravity in Shar’s name.

Quotes

“
Shar will take your sorrow from you

But beware: her night is dark.

She'll hide your pain, and secrets too.

And all your joy, and all your spark.
„
— A is for Azuth, and other Gods XI
“
In the beginning came morning, then night;

two sisters clashed - one dark and one light.

Selûne did call forth the moon and the stars;

Shar cloaked them in shadow to cover our scars.
„
— Plaques in Grymforge



“
Lady Shar's will shall be done. As sure as night will fall.
„
— Shadowheart, as she traverses the Shadowfell
